label: prf:categorical-instanton-exists
title: Proof of existence of categorical instantons
html:
Proof. Proof of existence of categorical instantons

The trivial connection \nabla_0 = d has F_{\nabla_0} = 0, which is by definition \star_q-self-dual; hence the zero instanton exists. Non-trivial instantons exist on \mathrm{SU}_q(2)-bundles over the CR realisation (example) via categorical descent of the classical BPST instanton (self-duality).
